29/S0.subgoal: Introduce the scope and objectives of the lecture on auditory senses and immersive experiences.

29/S1.subgoal: Explain how auditory stimuli reinforce perception, increase believability, and enhance presence in virtual reality environments.

29/S2.subgoal: Define sound and describe its physical characteristics, including frequency, amplitude, and phase.

29/S3.subgoal: Describe the mechanism of the human auditory system, showing how sound is converted to neural impulses.

29/S4.subgoal: Summarize the importance of auditory senses in XR and outline the topics to be covered in subsequent lectures.
